reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its described purpose is to promote a rewards-program method involving sign-up bonuses, referrals, and point redemption for Amazon gift cards. The speaker presents the “Unlimited Trick” and new-number/incognito instructions as reward-process guidance, while the described material does not establish deception, victim loss, or a separate harmful mechanism.

I am getting a gift card of 750 points Which is a gift card of 50 rupees
And paste your referral link in the incognito tab and then you have to sign up with a new number
That's why I am making a video for you and if you can refer more people
they can refer their friends and for that you can get 100 coins which is a big opportunity for you the more you refer the more you can earn

opening.argument: The video ties a promised free reward directly to a viewer’s action: register through the speaker’s link, provide a mobile number, and pursue additional accounts. It advertises earning an Amazon gift card every day, then directs viewers to sign up before describing a bonus and redemption. That is not merely discussion of rewards; it is a concrete acquisition funnel in which the promised gift card is the reason to complete the external registration flow. The claimed benefit is unusually easy relative to the requested action, and the audience is encouraged to reproduce the process rather than independently evaluate it.

citations.quote: This Video Is About How To Earn Free Amazon Gift Card Everyday My Earning Proof Added Of Rs.2000
You have to sign up first It is a very simple process by entering your mobile number The sign up link is in the description of this video
if you sign up with my link and after signing up you get a 100 coin sign up bonus

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a rewards program does not resolve the solicitation. The cited sign-up and referral language shows that viewers are being moved through an external registration process, while the alleged benefit is used to motivate that action. A displayed redemption is not independent proof that every viewer can obtain the promised reward through the advertised flow, nor does it establish the terms, limitations, or safety of the linked service.

citations.quote: And as you can see as soon as I filled my details And I have also got a code from Amazon
This unlimited trick will always work in your account, but you have to have mobile numbers

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument relies on the existence of a sign-up and referral pathway, but those features are ordinary mechanics of a rewards service and do not by themselves show fraud. The video shows a gift-card redemption process and describes a specific point exchange, so the reward is not merely an unsupported promise. Nothing cited establishes that registration causes loss, that the service withholds rewards, or that the external link is deceptive.

citations.quote: I am getting a gift card of 750 points Which is a gift card of 50 rupees
And if you have 2 more numbers, then you can take an Amazon gift card of 20 rupees

opening.argument: Several red flags appear together: the speaker promises an “unlimited” gift-card method, calls it a bypass trick, requires a new number and incognito browsing, and urges viewers to act quickly. Those are not ordinary details of a transparent promotion; they suggest the advertised result depends on evading normal account or offer controls. The method also requires repeated sign-ups and mobile-data manipulation rather than a straightforward disclosed reward path. Even without proving a particular victim’s loss, presenting an easy, repeatable benefit through these evasive instructions is strong evidence of a scam-like acquisition claim.

citations.quote: That's why I am making a video for you and if you can refer more people That is, you can do this by the bypass trick
before using this trick You have to use your chrome browser And you have to turn on your mobile data from the flight mode
And paste your referral link in the incognito tab and then you have to sign up with a new number
go fast link is in the description download it and use unlimited trick

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a deposit or explicit victim does not neutralize the red flags. The issue is the combination of an unlimited promise with instructions to cycle new numbers and conceal the flow in incognito mode. Describing those steps as a “trick” and urging viewers to go fast is materially different from simply explaining ordinary points redemption. The reference opening omits the bypass and evasion instructions that define the risk.

citations.quote: This unlimited trick will always work in your account, but you have to have mobile numbers
gift card, which I have shown you by doing it and I have shown you the redeem instant

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The language is informal promotional language, but it still describes a referral-and-points mechanism rather than proving deception. Incognito mode, Chrome, and a new number are asserted conditions; they do not establish that controls are being bypassed unlawfully or that anyone loses money. The on-screen material includes successful redemption records, which is consistent with a rewards offer even if the unlimited claim remains unverified.

citations.quote: So here I click on the redeem button And here I fill my details

opening.argument: Although presented as a demonstration and proof, the video functions as direct promotion. It sends viewers to a sign-up link, advertises a referral bonus, tells them to open the linked service, and ends by urging them to download and use the trick. The speaker also asks viewers to subscribe and promises that more referrals produce more earnings, turning supposed instruction into audience acquisition. The screenshots and claimed personal success serve as testimonials supporting participation, not neutral verification. The practical takeaway is to follow the speaker’s route to obtain a supposedly unlimited reward.

citations.quote: The sign up link is in the description of this video You first sign up
Now here is an unlimited trick for you guys I will show you live
So you also go and loot this website, it is the latest trick of 2020 to earn Amazon gift card
the more you refer the more you can earn so go fast link is in the description download it and use unlimited trick

rebuttal.rebuttal: The claimed instructional role is precisely what makes the promotion effective: the speaker supplies the destination, procedure, urgency, and personal proof in one package. A tutorial can still be a solicitation when its intended outcome is to drive registrations and referrals. The reference opening describes the mechanics but does not answer why the video repeatedly directs viewers toward the speaker’s link and urges immediate use of an allegedly unlimited method.

citations.quote: If you are visiting our channel for the first time Then start subscribing And set the bell next to get all notifications
Already I have taken redeem from here many times, if you guys that it is fake, then I will show you the redeem proof

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A call to subscribe and a referral link are common in promotional tutorials and do not establish a scam. The video identifies the activity as earning points and redeeming them for gift cards, and the screens show redemption history rather than an invented investment return. The quoted calls to action show advocacy, but they do not show that the service is fake, that the reward cannot be redeemed, or that viewers are asked to pay.
